newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss may drop opposition to IMF gold sales - report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss may drop opposition to IMF gold sales - report.

text.p: Switzerland could ease its opposition to IMF gold sales if wealthy countries fail to finance adequately a debt relief fund for poor countries, Swiss Finance Minister Kaspar Villiger was quoted as saying.

"If rich countries' contributions do not provide sufficient financing of debt relief, Switzerland might indeed agree to an IMF sale of gold, which it still rejects at present," the Swiss SDA news agency quoted him as saying in Washington.
In this case, it would reduce the 40 million Swiss francs it has pledged to the so-called Highly Indebted Poor Countries debt relief plan, he said. --Zurich Newsroom +41 1 631 7340
